record.question: Write R for those activities performed by a government servant requiring permission/sanction of the prescribed authority and NR for those not requiring sanction of the prescribed authority: (i) To join educational institution or course of studies for University degree. (ii) To publish a book himself or through a publisher in the bona fide discharge of his duties. (iii) Giving evidence at any judicial enquiry. (iv) To attend and speak at functions and ceremonies performed by others in respect of purely non-political or cultural institutions. (v) To own wholly or in part or conduct or participate in editing or management of any newspaper or other periodical publication or electronic media. (vi) Acceptance of a part-time lectureship in an educational institution which is in the nature of a regular remunerative occupation. (vii) To participate in the fund raising efforts of the 'National Foundation for Communal Harmony'. (viii) To undertake occasional work of a literary, artistic or scientific character. (ix) To be members of or actively participate in the activities of Indo-Foreign Cultural Organization. (x) To accept international awards.
